pv_generation_watts.help: Current PV (inverter input) power in watts.

grid_net_watts.help: Net grid power in watts (positive = export by default).

battery_net_watts.help: Battery net power in watts (positive = charging, negative = discharging).

battery_soc_percent.help: Battery state of charge in percent.

phase_a_voltage_volts.help: Phase A to-neutral grid voltage in volts.

phase_b_voltage_volts.help: Phase B to-neutral grid voltage in volts.

phase_c_voltage_volts.help: Phase C to-neutral grid voltage in volts.

phase_a_power_watts.help: Phase A active power in watts.

phase_b_power_watts.help: Phase B active power in watts.

phase_c_power_watts.help: Phase C active power in watts.

grid_export_watts.help: Current power exported to the grid in watts (>= 0).

grid_import_watts.help: Current power imported from the grid in watts (>= 0).

home_consumption_watts.help: Home consumption in watts (PV input minus battery power minus net grid power).

battery_charge_watts.help: Battery charging power in watts (0 when not charging).

battery_discharge_watts.help: Battery discharging power in watts (0 when not discharging).
